# Load Packages
```{r, results='hide'}
library(here)
library(patchwork)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(ggrepel)
library(DESeq2)
library(tibble)
```

# Set-up
## General settings
```{r, results='hide'}
# P-value for DESeq2 analysis
pvalue <- 0.01

# Minimal count of a TE to be taken along in the statistical analysis
lowCounts <- 10

# False Discovery Rate (FDR)
FDR <- 0.05

# Directory holding the count files written by 5_counting.sh
countsDir <- "counts"
```

## Sample information
```{r, results='hide'}
# Sample list
## Names are the column labels used below, values are the sample names from 5_counting.sh
samples <- c(wt1    = "PROseq1_piwi6_wt",
             wt2    = "PROseq2_piwi6_wt",
             ko10_1 = "PROseq1_piwi6_ko10",
             ko10_2 = "PROseq2_piwi6_ko10",
             ko52_1 = "PROseq1_piwi6_ko52",
             ko52_2 = "PROseq2_piwi6_ko52")

# Sample groups, used for the condition means further down
samples_WT   <- c("wt1", "wt2")
samples_KO   <- c("ko10_1", "ko10_2", "ko52_1", "ko52_2")
samples_KO10 <- c("ko10_1", "ko10_2")
samples_KO52 <- c("ko52_1", "ko52_2")

# Column data
## condition  = WT, KO         (ko10 and ko52 pooled)
## condition2 = WT, KO10, KO52 (three groups)
## batch      = the two PRO-seq runs, included as a covariate in both designs
coldata <- data.frame(row.names  = names(samples),
                      batch      = factor(c("1", "2", "1", "2", "1", "2")),
                      condition  = factor(c("WT", "WT", "KO", "KO", "KO", "KO")),
                      condition2 = factor(c("WT", "WT", "KO10", "KO10", "KO52", "KO52")))
```

## Load count table
```{r, results='hide'}
# Count table
## Reads the ${sample}_counts.tsv files produced by 5_counting.sh
countstable <- imap(samples, ~ read_tsv(here(countsDir, paste0(.x, "_counts.tsv")),
                                        col_names = c("transposon", .y))) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = "transposon")

# Count matrix
count_matrix <- countstable %>%
  column_to_rownames("transposon") %>%
  as.matrix()
```

# DESeq2 analysis
```{r, results='hide'}
# Create a DESeq2 DataSet to see the difference between WT and KO (ko10 and ko52 together)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_matrix,
                              colData   = coldata,
                              design    = ~condition + batch)
dds$condition <- relevel(dds$condition, ref = "WT")
## Drop the TEs with too few reads to test
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) > lowCounts, ]

# Create a DESeq2 DataSet to see the difference between WT, KO10 and KO52
dds2 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_matrix,
                               colData   = coldata,
                               design    = ~condition2 + batch)
dds2$condition2 <- relevel(dds2$condition2, ref = "WT")
## Drop the TEs with too few reads to test
dds2 <- dds2[rowSums(counts(dds2)) > lowCounts, ]

# DESeq2
## DESeq_PROseq  is used for the KO vs WT statistics and the scatter and volcano plots
DESeq_PROseq  <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)
## DESeq2_PROseq is used for the normalised counts in the KO vs KO scatterplot
DESeq2_PROseq <- DESeq(dds2, quiet = TRUE)
```

# Volcano/Scatter plots
## Set-up
```{r, results='hide'}
# Transposable element groups
TE_GROUPS <- list(LTR       = c("LTR_Pao","LTR_Gypsy","LTR_Copia","LTR", "AeERV1"),
                  LINE      = c("LINE","LINE_R1","LINE_RTE","LINE_Penelope","LINE_L1","LINE_I"),
                  DNA       = c("DNA","DNA_CMC","DNA_hAT","DNA_Kolobok","DNA_MULE","DNA_PIF","DNA_Sola","DNA_TcMar","DNA_Zator"),
                  RC        = "RC_Helitron",
                  Satellite = "Satellite",
                  SINE      = "SINE_tRNA",
                  Unknown   = "Unknown")

# Colors for the transposable element groups
TE_COLORS <- c(LTR       = "#0A8974",
               LINE      = "#E27520",
               DNA       = "#E49C23",
               RC        = "#E3072A",
               Satellite = "#6362A9",
               SINE      = "#5FAECC",
               Unknown   = "#C2C8E7",
               NS        = "gray")

# Shared layers for the scatter and dot panels
ablines     <- list(geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0),
                    geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=1),
                    geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=-1))
log2scale_s <- list(scale_x_continuous(trans="log2", limits=c(0.5,20000)),
                    scale_y_continuous(trans="log2", limits=c(0.5,20000)))
log2scale_d <- list(scale_x_continuous(trans="log2", limits=c(0.5,NA)),
                    scale_y_continuous(trans="log2", limits=c(0.5,NA)))

# Shared layers for the volcano panel
vlines <- list(geom_vline(xintercept=c(-1, 1), linetype="longdash"),
               geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="longdash"))

# Shared theme for all panels
base_theme <- theme(legend.title=element_blank(),
                    panel.background=element_blank(),
                    axis.line=element_line())

# Shared legend placement, inside the panel
legend_inside <- theme(legend.position = c(0.03, 0.75),
                       legend.justification = c(0, 0))
```

## Piwi6 KO vs WT results
```{r, results='hide'}
# Extract the pvalue, padj, etc.
KOvsWT <- results(DESeq_PROseq, alpha = pvalue, contrast = c("condition", "KO", "WT")) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("TE") %>%
  as_tibble()
```

## Annotated counts tables
```{r, results='hide'}
# Extract the normalised counts for the requested condition means, join the DESeq2 statistics,
# and annotate with TE type, display name, significance call and colour group
annotate_counts <- function(deseq_obj, res, mean_spec) {
  norm <- counts(deseq_obj, normalized = TRUE, replaced = FALSE) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  means <- imap(mean_spec, ~ unname(rowMeans(norm[, .x, drop = FALSE])) + 0.5)
  as_tibble(means) %>%
    mutate(TE = rownames(norm), .before = 1) %>%
    left_join(res, by = "TE") %>%
    mutate(padj        = replace_na(padj, 1),
           sign        = ifelse(padj <= FDR, "significant", "NS"),
           TEtypeSign  = coalesce(str_extract(TE, "(?<=\\d@)\\w+"),
                                  str_extract(TE, "(?<=Consensus_\\d{1,3}_)[A-Za-z0-9]+(?=loci)")),
           TE_name     = coalesce(str_replace(str_extract(TE, "family-\\d+@[^@]+$"),
                                              "(family-\\d+)@(.+)", "\\2 \\1") %>%
                                  str_replace("_", "/") %>%
                                  str_replace(" ", "\n"),
                                  str_extract(TE, "(?<=Consensus_\\d{1,3}_)[A-Za-z0-9]+(?=loci)")),
           color_group = case_when(sign == "NS"                   ~ "NS",
                                   TEtypeSign %in% TE_GROUPS$LTR  ~ "LTR",
                                   TEtypeSign %in% TE_GROUPS$LINE ~ "LINE",
                                   TEtypeSign %in% TE_GROUPS$DNA  ~ "DNA",
                                   TEtypeSign %in% TE_GROUPS$RC   ~ "RC",
                                   TEtypeSign == "Satellite"      ~ "Satellite",
                                   TEtypeSign == "SINE_tRNA"      ~ "SINE",
                                   TEtypeSign == "Unknown"        ~ "Unknown",
                                   TRUE ~ "NS"))}

# Extract normalised counts for KO vs WT and add the pvalue, padj, etc.
counts_KOvsWT <- annotate_counts(DESeq_PROseq, KOvsWT,
                                 list(meanWT = samples_WT,
                                      meanKO = samples_KO))

# Extract normalised counts for KO vs KO and add the pvalue, padj, etc.
counts_KOvsKO <- annotate_counts(DESeq2_PROseq, KOvsWT,
                                 list(meanko10 = samples_KO10,
                                      meanko52 = samples_KO52))
```

## Scatterplot of KO vs WT
```{r, results='hide'}
s1 <- ggplot(counts_KOvsWT, aes(meanWT, meanKO)) +
  geom_point(data = \(df) df[df$sign == "NS", ],
             colour = "gray", size=6, alpha=0.6) +
  geom_point(data = \(df) df[df$sign == "significant", ],
             aes(colour = color_group), size=6, alpha=0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = TE_COLORS) +
  ablines +
  log2scale_s +
  labs(x = "Wild-type (mean counts + 0.5)",
       y = "Piwi6 KO (mean counts + 0.5)") +
  base_theme +
  legend_inside +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5))
```

## Volcano plot of KO vs WT
```{r, results='hide'}
# Labels: strongly up-regulated repeats, placed to the right of the panel
v1 <- ggplot(counts_KOvsWT, aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(data = \(df) df[df$sign == "NS", ],
             colour = "gray", size = 6, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = \(df) df[df$sign == "significant", ],
             aes(colour = color_group), size = 6, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = TE_COLORS) +
  geom_label_repel(data = \(df) subset(df, log2FoldChange > 2 & sign == "significant" & -log10(padj) > 0.05), aes(label = TE_name), nudge_x = 2,
                   direction = "y", hjust = 0, xlim = c(max(counts_KOvsWT$log2FoldChange) + 2, Inf), segment.color = "grey40", segment.size = 0.4,
                   segment.alpha = 0.8, fill = alpha(c("white"), 0.6), colour = "black", size = 5, label.padding = unit(0.5, "lines"),
                   box.padding = unit(0.4, "lines"), point.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"), min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-5, 5), clip = "off") +
  vlines +
  labs(x = "Log2 FC (Piwi6 KO/WT)",
       y = "-Log10 (adjusted P value)") +
  base_theme +
  legend_inside +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 100, 5.5, 5.5))
```

## Scatterplot of KO vs KO
```{r, results='hide'}
s2 <- ggplot(counts_KOvsKO, aes(meanko10, meanko52)) +
  geom_point(data = \(df) df[df$color_group == "NS", ],
             colour = TE_COLORS["NS"], size = 6, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = \(df) df[df$color_group != "NS", ],
             aes(colour = color_group), size = 6, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = TE_COLORS) +
  ablines +
  log2scale_d +
  labs(x = "Piwi6 KO#10 (mean counts + 0.5)",
       y = "Piwi6 KO#52 (mean counts + 0.5)") +
  base_theme +
  legend_inside +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5))
```
